text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Well look at that, Blast-chan! 
Up bright and early today, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You guys are up even earlier than me, 
though. 
Thanks for always keeping things in shape!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
(The academy turf is always sparkling 
clean.)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
(So that we won't get hurt. 
...So that we can run all we want. 
Because of how hard you take care of it 
for us.)

text_block_list.name: Young Blast
text_block_list.text:
Why are you always smiling, Coach? 
Isn't it boring just watching us race?

text_block_list.name: Youth Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! 
I just love seeing you run, 
Boo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Youth Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
As long as you can keep running on and 
on... 
that alone makes me happy, Boo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
......Boo wants to make all the people 
she loves super happy too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I want to protect it. 
...The bond between Umamusume and the 
humans 
who bring us together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean we get to practice every 
single day 
from now on for the Shuntaisai?!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, even the ritual staff are lending a 
hand!

That's right, the ritual staff are helping 
out too!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And the practice will take place at the 
actual 
"Program Venue," just like the real event.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! 
Can I practice as much as I want? 
I'd really love to do some extra solo 
training too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...During the spring workshop, Blast 
Onepiece was crestfallen 
after finding herself unable to perform at 
all. 
This training camp is her chance to turn 
things around.
choice_data_list: Of course! Let's level up this summer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside the Divine Steeds, 
I stepped foot into the Program Venue once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thus began the special training camp 
in preparation for the Goshiki Shuntaisai!
